features.source: https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/monthly/fundingRate/{SYMBOL}/{SYMBOL}-fundingRate-{YYYY-MM}.zip; frozen gap fallback GET https://fapi.binance.com/fapi/v1/fundingRate?symbol={SYMBOL}&startTime={MONTH_START_MS}&endTime={MONTH_END_MS}&limit=1000, deterministically paged
features.available_time: strictly after funding_time; context requires funding_time < decision t
features.lag: latest row tau<t; b=ceil_8h_UTC(s); require b+8h=t
features.transformation: 180d same-settlement-hour median/MAD z-score (min 20); all-hour fallback min 60; scale floor 1e-5; clip +/-6; subtract contemporaneous cross-sectional median (min 8)

features.available_time: at close; runner exposes only bars closed by t
features.lag: response bar must end at t; fill open t is hidden
features.transformation: log(close/open), 180d UTC-slot median (min 30; all-hour min 90), BTC beta on 270 prior bars min 120, residual MAD on 90 prior bars min 60, cross-sectional median min 8
features.missing: BTC fallback is per-bar median of >=10 current PIT names with >=120 pairs; otherwise zero signal

features.source: canonical membership.parquet derived from completed Binance quote_volume bars: Monday 00 UTC, prior 30 complete days, median daily quote volume, min 30 dates plus prior date, top 40
features.available_time: at Monday reconstitution; intersected with executable open at t
features.transformation: membership/risk boundary only; quote volume is not alpha
features.missing: exclude symbol; central participation/delist logic remains active
